rv.q: Fleming's precise phrasing and stirring delivery alone are almost worth the price of admission.
As Clara, Dove Cameron had a huge part which she handled with seeming ease.

Ably directed here by Daniel Evans, with a curved half-ruined wall of a set by Robert Jones that's akin to a Getty Villa wannabe, the problem with Piazza is not with the singing: Emmy award-winning Disney TV and film star Dove Cameron (who's got more than 30 million Instagram followers) sails through her often frenetic moods with vocal ease.
